correctness.rationale: The Bézout rectangle identity follows by clearing denominators; the positive and negative terms are disjoint modulo a and within each rectangle no degrees repeat. For b=as+2 the occupied residues form one interval per a-row; boundary lengths decrease by twos and then increase by twos, each stage of length s. For b=au−2, u=s+1≥2, the early two-component rows each contribute u occurrences of their even interior gap, the central separation contributes a further u at length two, and the late boundary stages give u of each even length from 4 through 2h−2. The outermost boundaries contribute 2(u−1) at 2h. At h=2 the late intermediate stages are empty and the last u−1 boundaries still have length 2h. The rectangle counts minus one minus the nonunit gaps give the two unit counts. This argument uses coprimality, not primality. Independent finite coefficient reconstruction followed by gap measurement (python3 /workspace/branches/f752dabd-f88a-4b0c-8710-5aaa8112414e/gap_spectrum_probe.py) matched all 224 cases a=5,7,…,31, s=1,…,8 and both signs, including (9,20) and (9,25). The uploaded checker was not run; the all-parameter result follows from the row proof.
